helpMessage: Do !help {command} for info on how to use any command (!cmds to see a list of commands), and message @cherryrntz on discord for feedback / support.

imNewMessage: Welcome to Obamagang! I am a guild bot run by @cherryrntz and @xbqst, and I respond to commands sent in the guild chat, discord, or /w.
rankHelpMessage: Our guild has three obtainable ranks: Elite, Competitive, and Staff. Elite requires 75k weekly GEXP (check yours with !gexp), and Competitive and Staff require an application in our guild discord.
usefulCommandsMessage: Try !duels, !player, !skyblock and !bedwars for various Hypixel stats for any player. To find new commands, try !randomcommand or !cmds.
botInfoMessage: @xbqst and @cherryrntz maintain our guild bot, which responds to any command sent in guild chat, discord or /w. (WIP not informative enough)
skyblockMenuMessage: Type !sb <command> to run a skyblock related command and !sb cmds to see a list of options.
staffOnlyMessage: [ERROR] You do not have permission to run this command! If you believe this to be an error, try running the command from Minecraft chat.
inactivityInfoMessage: We recognise that nobody can be active 24/7. If and when you take a break, please let us know in the #inactivity channel in our discord.
broadcasts: Don't forget to join our guild discord! Do /g discord to receive the invite link.
Need to familiarise yourself with our bot? Use !help, !cmds, or !randomcommand.
Have any feedback or an idea for a new feature? Ping or message @cherryrntz on discord.
Want to learn more about our guild? !info for more information on things like our ranks system, our guild bot, and more.
